name: eval_sigma_calibration_30seed
notes: Sigma calibration study (docs/项目记录/突变序列迭代搜索算法与代理接口实施方案_20261002.md §5 gates): does the XGB bootstrap ensemble sigma stratify |error| and does any LCB (mu-beta*sigma) beat plain greedy on top-5%/10% recall, on independent dev folds, at n_train=1600 and the closed-loop scale 400, with a shuffled-label negative control. 30 seeds (301-330, disjoint from other study ranges). Gate output is written into summary.json; uncertainty-based acquisition stays closed unless the gates pass. PROXY-table diagnostics only.
